tasks.label: Executar Resta Um
args: if (Get-Process main -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Stop-Process -Name main -Force }; & 'C:\raylib\w64devkit\bin\gcc.exe' main_3d.c resta_um.c -o main.exe -IC:\raylib\raylib\src -LC:\raylib\raylib\src -lraylib -lopengl32 -lgdi32 -lwinmm; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { & '.\main.exe' }
